text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Kabariti meets PLO chief Arafat in Gaza on Sunday, discussions to cover the negotiations on the Palestinian track and Israel's commitment to peace accords.
- Kabariti on a tour to industrial firms and expresses the government's readiness to standardise customs and taxes imposed on imported goods.
- Campaigners against the first Israeli trade fair say their protests were a success, assert Jordan will not be a gateway to the Israeli economy's entry into the Arab world.
- A steep drop in the stock market and volume in its lowest levels, with losing stocks outstripping gainers.
- Crown Prince Hassan returns after "extremely successful" visit to Spain.
